youtube.baslik: Why do we record the time the dizziness started? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: If a patient with acute, continuous dizziness shows a central pattern or a warning sign, the planned test battery is put on hold at once and the facility's emergency referral route is used. The time of symptom onset, or the time last known well, is recorded; some stroke treatments are possible only in the first hours. The patient is not sent alone or driving; a short summary of the findings is passed on, if possible with a video recording of the eye movements.
